segments.thag6.7:1.1: “Uṭṭhehi nisīda kātiyāna, mā niddābahulo ahu jāgarassu;
segments.thag6.7:1.3: Mā taṃ alasaṃ pamattabandhu, kūṭeneva jinātu maccurājā.
segments.thag6.7:2.3: So karohi sudīpamattano tvaṃ, na hi tāṇaṃ tava vijjateva aññaṃ.
segments.thag6.7:3.1: “Satthā hi vijesi maggametaṃ, saṅgā jātijarābhayā atītaṃ;
segments.thag6.7:4.3: Mā khiḍḍāratiñca mā niddaṃ, anuyuñjittha jhāya kātiyāna.
segments.thag6.7:5.3: Pappuyya anuttaraṃ visuddhiṃ, parinibbāhisi vārināva joti.
segments.thag6.7:6.3: Evampi tuvaṃ anādiyāno, māraṃ indasagotta niddhunāhi;
segments.thag6.7:6.5: So vedayitāsu vītarāgo, kālaṃ kaṅkha idheva sītibhūto”ti.
